issues: DashboardScreen.tsx:129 – style contains a hard‑coded `fontSize: 32`. All font sizes must be taken from the design tokens (e.g. `theme.typography` or a shared component) instead of literal values. Replace the literal with a theme‑based value such as `theme.typography.headlineMedium.fontSize` or a custom `SummaryCard` style that uses the theme.

SignInScreen.tsx:93,97,99 – UI strings contain literal Unicode escape sequences (`\u2019`, `\u2026`). These are rendered literally, causing the UI flow test to fail (cannot locate link "Don’t have an account? Sign up"). Replace the escaped characters with the actual characters (’, …) or use a JSX expression (`{'Don'}’t ...`). Update both the `accessibilityLabel` and the displayed text accordingly.

SignInScreen.tsx:93 – The link to the Sign‑Up screen is implemented as a `PaperButton` with an `accessibilityLabel` that contains the escaped Unicode sequence. After fixing the escape characters, ensure the button’s accessible name matches exactly "Don’t have an account? Sign up" so the primary flow test can locate and click it.
feedback: The functional tests pass, but static validation fails due to UI styling and text issues. Replace all hard‑coded font sizes (and similar literal values) with values from the theme, and remove literal Unicode escapes in UI strings. Fix the accessibility label on the Sign‑In screen’s Sign‑Up link to match the expected text. After these changes, the screens will use the shared design tokens, the UI text will be correct, and the primary flow test should succeed.
